name: Dialog
summary: A modal window on the native <dialog>, with a header, a scrolling body, a footer, three sizes and an alert dialog for confirms.
description:
Use a dialog when people must answer or finish something before they go back to the page, such as a confirm, a short form or a decision. For extra detail that does not block the page, use a drawer or a popover instead.

Open it with showModal() so the browser adds the backdrop, the focus trap, Escape and focus return. Buttons inside <form method="dialog"> close it without any script.

classes.name: v-dialog
classes.description: The dialog panel, on a <dialog> element. Animates in and out where the browser supports it.

classes.name: v-dialog-header
classes.description: Top row with the title and the close button.

classes.name: v-dialog-title
classes.description: The heading. Point aria-labelledby at its id.

classes.name: v-dialog-close
classes.description: The corner close button, usually a ghost icon button inside <form method="dialog">.

classes.name: v-dialog-body
classes.description: The content. Only this part scrolls, so the title and actions stay in view.

classes.name: v-dialog-footer
classes.description: The actions, aligned to the end. On phones the buttons share the width.

classes.name: v-dialog-icon
classes.description: A round tone icon beside the title, for alert dialogs.

classes.name: v-dialog-full
classes.description: As wide as lg, and the whole screen on phones. Suits longer forms.

classes.name: v-dialog-danger
classes.description: Danger tone for the icon, for destructive confirms.

states.description: Set by showModal() or show(). The dialog is shown; without it the dialog is hidden.
An alert or confirm dialog: narrower (26rem) and announced as urgent. Add aria-describedby on the message.
On a button inside, picks which control gets focus on open. Use it on the safe choice in a destructive confirm.

keyboard.action: Moves focus between the controls inside. Focus stays in the dialog while it is open.
Closes the dialog and fires its cancel event.
Presses the focused button. A button in <form method="dialog"> closes the dialog and sets its returnValue.

a11y: Open with showModal(), not the open attribute: only a modal dialog makes the page behind it inert and traps focus.
Name it with aria-labelledby pointing at the .v-dialog-title, and give the icon-only close button an aria-label.
When the dialog closes, focus returns to the button that opened it.
In a destructive confirm, name the action on the button (Delete, not OK) and put autofocus on the safe choice.

examples.title: Modal dialog
examples.description: The dialog sits closed in the markup; the button opens it with showModal(). Cancel, Send invite and the close button all close it through <form method="dialog">.
